nativeReceiptContract.hitCallbackBatches: One per actually resolved enemy parent application, registered after damage calculation and before end-of-frame application task; pending until run, completed or blocked by hitConfirm policy. Missed geometry and skipped dead enemies have no batch.
nativeReceiptContract.hitCallbacks: One per actually executed post-nil-filter callback slot. The callback may be labelled by source site and produce exact tagged child queue IDs. A blocked batch executes no callback slots.
nativeReceiptContract.damageZero: Damage immunity alone still executes callbacks; hitConfirm blocked suppresses them.
nativeReceiptContract.copySemantics: The parent AttackEvent is copied per target, while each callback closure done flag is shared by all copies from that queued parent attack.
nativeReceiptContract.originRule: Tagged children are callback-origin descendants of the one audited parent attack; do not count unrelated event/weapon/artifact queues or later player actions.

rows.label: 多莉 E：烦恼解决炮与售后服务弹

callback.guard: closure done bool is false only for first actually executed slot0 across all hit targets; no explicit Target.Type guard, but current native callback dispatch here is enemy-only

children.pattern: CircleHit around current player/primary target at callback time; actual geometry/target hits are source receipts

rows.termination: All parent checked-target outcomes and any registered end-of-frame batches must be terminal; first executed intrinsic callback must have its exact 2/3 child queues and all children dispatched with each checked target terminal. If all parent targets miss/die/are hitConfirm blocked, zero callback children are valid only with those explicit terminal receipts.
rows.parameterAndConstellationGates: travel changes parent delivery frame, not attack count; Init sets afterCount=2 and C1 increments once to3. All constellations included for intrinsic E damage. C6 infusion affects later normal/charged/plunge actions.
rows.excluded: A1 reduces E cooldown via reaction events; A4 callback restores energy; particle callback makes particles; C6 infusion and later normal attacks are separate; stellar A1 also listens to StellarConduct but adds no E damage root.

callbackSites.childCount: fact, source-constrained to 2 if C0 and 3 if C1+

rows.label: 米卡 E 长按：霜星矢与实际命中的霜星碎片

eligibility.holdParam: nonzero selects hold branch; zero press branch already source-audited in batch 110

callback.guard: Requires Enemy target, then shared done false. Root is single-target, so normally at most one executed slot1.

children.countOnProductiveCallback: exact actual len(RandomEnemiesWithinArea), 0..3; equals mika.skill.selected-shards fact
children.selection: Alive enemies within player-centered radius10 area, excluding hit parent target; Rand.Perm selects up to3 without duplicates. Do not infer which targets or count from static declarations.

rows.termination: Parent must be dispatched with terminal target outcome; if resolved and hitConfirm normal, slot1 must execute and have 0..3 child queues equal recorded selected count. If missed/dead/blocked, no shards only when explicit terminal receipts prove it. Every queued shard must dispatch and have terminal target outcomes.
rows.parameterAndConstellationGates: hold !=0 required; shard callback exists at all ascension/constellation levels. C2 plus A1 adds optional slot2 detector stack callback, not damage. If C<2 or A<1, slot2 is nil and removed.
rows.excluded: Mika press has separate batch110 fixed-one-root branch; particle callback at slot0 creates particles; each shard optional A1 callback adds Detector stack, C2 adds stack on parent, A4 event subscription adds stack, C6 modifies later physical damage. applyBuffs character task does not emit attacks.

proposedRule.when: source condition p["hold"] != 0, including negative nonzero; current 109 DSL compare lacks neq, so use a lazy if(eq hold 0) branch or extend compare neq before integration

rows.integrationConstraint: Existing batch110 mika-skill plan has when hold==0. Widen only with callback rule; implement exact native !=0 branch (not >0). Otherwise hold remains partial, never root-only complete.

remainingGaps: This is source-audited simulator behavior, not a claim of game-measured hit rates or shard target probabilities.
